text:
hana: small PR to fix console quickstart examples: unify trace header to `x-rd-trace`, update JS cost snippet to `usage.tokens`, and remove a stale `kv_prefetch` line. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2482

loki: thanks — can you add a 1-line note for customers on pinned SDKs <2.3? they hit telemetry field churn.

hana: added compatibility note linking to /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3.

rene: docs-bot flagged a broken internal link in the change set. docs-bot, paste the error?
docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken link in docs/console/quickstart.md line 129 -> /sdk/telemetry/old (404). Suggested replacement: /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3.

loki: i'll open a tiny site-config redirect once this merges.

hana: updated the node snippet and pushed a fixup. also added a short "Docs note" about cost numbers shifting ~5% due to batching defaults. not a big customer change but worth calling out.

rene: left 2 micro-nits on wording; otherwise LGTM. loki, can you land the redirect PR after merge?
loki: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/318 for a 301 from /sdk/telemetry/old -> /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3. will follow up with infra.

hana: squashed and merging after CI if green. thanks all :pray:
